liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): The performance of this song caused the listener to scream with excitement [11]
- **If I Had The World To Give** (1 review): The reviewer considers this an overlooked timeless ballad that should be played more [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.miller.89257.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry Garcia's voice is described as crisp in this specific recording [13]
- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.unknown.32906.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording is remarkably crisp, with clear separation of instruments and vocals [12]
- **gd1978-10-17.138919.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.138919.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1978-10-17.mtx.motb-0092.100699.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: The matrix recording captures the dynamic atmosphere of the Winterland venue that night [22]
- **gd1978-10-17.mtx.motb-0092.100703.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 143 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: The sound quality is described as super special and highly immersive [16]
- **gd1978-10-17.fob.akgd224e.holwein.motb-0092.100692.flac24**: source not stated; 17 songs; 148 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [9]

## Around the show

- Phil Lesh commented on the World Series outcome before the show started [11]
- A girl asked Jerry for banjo lessons on stage before the final song [20]
- The reviewer listened to the tape while driving from Athens to San Francisco [21]
- During Space, Jerry was heard off-stage being asked about banjo lessons [3]
- The reviewer found this show the most energized of the five-night run [18]
- The reviewer believes this is the best show of the entire run [20]
- This is considered the best representation of the October 1978 Winterland shows [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.miller.89257.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: Patch material was supplied by Pat Lee and transferred by Matt Smith [1]
- **gd1978-10-17.sbd.unknown.32906.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>Master Reel>Cassette>DAT>WAV>FLAC>WAV>SHN [2]
- **gd1978-10-17.138919.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.138919.sbeok.flac16**: taped by From Gastwirt Collection; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: Soundboard > Master Reel > PCM > Dat (44k); Provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000 . wav 16/44.1; Transferred by… [3]. Also: Patch source was an AKG D224e mic into a Sony TC-158 recorder [3]
- **gd1978-10-17.mtx.motb-0092.100699.flac16**: transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [6]. Also: The matrix mixes 55% audience and 45% soundboard from C. Miller's source [6]
- **gd1978-10-17.mtx.motb-0092.100703.flac24**: transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [7]
- **gd1978-10-17.fob.akgd224e.holwein.motb-0092.100692.flac24**: taped by Reinhart Holwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG D224e => Sony TC-158 >> MAC [9]. Also: The taper was Reinhart, whom the reviewer attended high school with [19]
